## Terms and Conditions:
2. Sub-accounts are not eligible to participate in trading tasks on their own. Trading volume from sub-accounts will be counted towards their main account.

Exchange/platform: Binance
Headline: Sub-Affiliate Program: Grow Your Team, Qualify For Up to 5,000 USDC Reward Vouchers
Prize pool: 150K USDC
Start: 2026-11-27T10:00:00Z · End: 2027-02-28T23:59:00Z
Most one person can get (parsed): 5000 USDC
Smallest threshold (parsed): 50 USD (deposit)
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
Fellow Binancians,
Binance is launching the Sub-Affiliate Campaign for Affiliates interested in building a team. During the Promotion Period, Affiliates in the Sub-Affiliate Program can qualify for up to 5,000 USDC in token voucher rewards based on the challenge tier achieved on a first-come, first-served basis.
Join Now
Promotion Period: 2026-11-27 10:00 (UTC) - 2027-02-28 23:59 (UTC)
Eligible Participants: Existing Affiliates who have joined the Sub-Affiliates program feature
## How It Works
Step 1: Build Your Sub-Affiliate Team
An Affiliate can invite Sub-Affiliates to join their team and share a portion of their own commission rate to build the Sub-Affiliate team. Please refer to this FAQ for how to participate in the Binance Sub-Affiliate Feature.
Step 2: Sub-Affiliates Refer New Users
Sub-Affiliates invite new users to register during the Promotion Period, complete account verification (KYC), and make deposits and trading.
Step 3: Reward Distribution
After the Promotion Period ends, Affiliates could qualify for a reward of up to 5,000 USDC based on the achievement of each of the following three assessment metrics.
## Challenge Tiers and Rewards
Affiliates who meet all three metrics in any one challenge tier will qualify for the corresponding reward. Rewards are granted at the highest tier achieved and are not cumulative.
Challenge Tier | Qualified Sub-Affiliates* During the Promotion Period |  | Qualified New Users Referred** During the Promotion Period |  | Trading Volume Generated by Referred Users*** During the Promotion Period (in USDC) | Reward Per Eligible Affiliate (in USDC Token Vouchers)
1 | ≥3 | and | ≥10 | and | ≥1,000,000 | 100
2 | ≥10 | ≥30 | ≥3,000,000 | 300
3 | ≥20 | ≥100 | ≥10,000,000 | 1,000
4 | ≥30 | ≥200 | ≥30,000,000 | 3,000
5 | ≥40 | ≥300 | ≥50,000,000 | 5,000
## Important Notes
A Qualified Sub-Affiliate* must meet all of the following conditions:
Invited as a Sub-Affiliate by the Affiliate during the Promotion Period;
Refer at least 3 Qualified New Users via invitation links during the Promotion Period.
A Qualified New User Referred** must meet all of the following conditions:
New users who register via a Sub-Affiliate's invitation link during the Promotion Period, including all new users invited through Sub-Affiliates within the Affiliate's team;
Completed and passed KYC and all necessary account opening processes;
During the Promotion Period, the invited new user must complete deposits of ≥ 50 USD via Fiat deposit, Buy Crypto or P2P;
During the Promotion Period, the invited new user must complete their first trade and reach a cumulative trading volume of ≥ 100 USD, trading compliantly.
Qualified Referred Users’ Trading Volume*** must meet all of the following conditions:
New users who register via a Sub-Affiliate's invitation link during the Promotion Period;
Effective trading volume generated by referred users calculated by the total trading volume in Spot, Margin or Futures during the Promotion Period, excluding trading volume from zero-fee orders.
Affiliates must not (and must ensure that Sub-Affiliates do not) give investment advice, make recommendations, predict prices, or promise returns.
## Terms and Conditions
The Promotions are open to eligible Binance Affiliates only. Only users in certain regions are eligible to join the Promotions. Users in restricted regions are disqualified from participating in the Binance Affiliate Program (including the Sub-Affiliate Feature).
All affiliates are bound by the Affiliate Program Terms and the Sub-Affiliate Program Terms, and are specifically reminded to follow the Code of Conduct when carrying out any activities in the capacity of an affiliate.
Binance will use the price of the USDC trading pair at the time of trading to calculate the value of the trades completed on Binance Spot and Binance Futures during the Promotion Period. If there is no USDC pair for a specific cryptocurrency, it will be converted to another token or coin with a USDC pair to determine its value.
All trading volumes on Spot zero-fee trading pairs (AEUR/USDT, BNB/JPY, BTC/JPY, EUR/EURI, EURI/USDT, FDUSD/USDC, FDUSD/USDT, RLUSD/U, RLUSD/USDT, TUSD/USDT, USD1/USDC, USD1/USDT, USDC/USD, USDC/USDT, USDP/USDT, USDT/USD, U/USDC, U/USDT, XUSD/USDT) will not be considered as qualifying trading volume for the purposes of the Promotions.
Sub-accounts cannot be used to participate in the Promotions as either a referrer or a referral. Spot, Margin or Futures trades that are completed with a sub-account will not count toward the trading volume requirement.
## Reward Distribution:
The total prize pool is 150,000 USDC, distributed on a first-come, first-served basis. We will notify you if the prize pool is exhausted during the Promotion Period. Once the pool is fully distributed, subsequent participants will not be eligible for rewards;
If a Sub-Affiliate becomes "Restricted" (as defined in the Sub-Affiliate Program Terms) during the Promotion Period, that Sub-Affiliate's activity data will be removed in its entirety and will not count toward the Affiliate's campaign performance data in any of the metrics;
Rewards will be distributed manually within 21 days after the Promotion Period ends and users will be able to log in and redeem their token voucher rewards via Profile > Rewards Hub;
The validity period to claim the token voucher is set at 14 days from the day of distribution. Users should redeem the token vouchers before the expiry date. Thereafter, the token vouchers will become invalid. Learn how to redeem a voucher.
At Binance's sole discretion, user participation will be considered without effect and users will automatically be excluded, disqualified and prevented from accumulating benefits, in cases where it is identified that there is or has been:
Any violations of Binance's Terms of Use, Affiliate Terms, Sub-Affiliate Terms, or any other terms that a participant may be subject to;
Any attempted or proven fraud, whether human and/or through the use of technology;
Manipulation of results or failure to fulfill the requirements and provisions set forth in these Terms and Conditions;
Completion, by the user, of incorrect, outdated, mistaken information or using any untrue information in order to participate in the Promotion;
Registrations and participations for which any technological means have been used or there are indications of their use, whether electronic, computerized, digital, robotic, repetitive, automatic, mechanical and/or analogous, with the intention of automatic and/or repetitive reproduction of registrations, identical or not, which will also result in the nullity of all registrations and participations made by the user who has used one of the aforementioned means or for one of the aforementioned purposes, even if not all registrations or participations have resulted from the use of such means and/or were carried out with such purpose.
There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise.
